blocks.html: IV Therapy is utilized to administer beneficial vitamins and medications directly into your bloodstream, bypassing the digestive tract to allow for instant and optimal absorption. The age and condition and quality of vitamins can affect the absorption and bio-availability.

With pill supplements, quality and age, as well as your unique absorption rates, can keep you from getting the full benefit of treatment. Liquid extracts can be better, but there is still the problem of inefficient absorption, age of supplement and efficacy through your digestive system.
IV therapy allows helpful substances to go directly into your bloodstream. You take in virtually all of what is administered. It goes directly to where it can help the most.

IV therapy has been embraced by many people all over the world as a pure and effective way to improve health, increase weight loss, replenish depleted stores of nutrients and flush out damaging toxins.

The IVs used during IV infusion therapy are exactly the same medical grade equipment that you would find in a hospital. However, in contrast to the clinical IV experience, IV Infusion Therapy offers a calming, relaxing and revitalizing treatment session administered in a tranquil, attractive spa setting.
